description: Read the access settings of a folder or an asset. Returns: your own access level (full_access, comment, view or none) and whether you are its creator / a team member, the creator (name, avatar), the default levels for team members and for anyone with the link, and the team's member count. It does NOT list individual people - use members for the team's people. Pass folder_id for a folder, or asset_id for an asset (an asset id or any of its version ids - versions use their asset's settings). Read-only: the user changes sharing in the Flask app, from the asset's or folder's url.
name: permission_get
title: Get access settings
